run.name: Coherent Corp
run.title: CP-OS host session (COHR)
run.summary: Fundamentals are sound but stretched by growth: strong margins, 2.58x total and 1.46x net analyst leverage and 2,421.9 million of liquidity, against negative free cash flow, two large customers and unquantified commitments. Launched through CP-OS as of 2026-11-05 on the retained context; the EDGAR registrant name in that context is COHERENT CORP..

revenue.basis: Revenues, as the CP-1 table prints it.

ebitda.basis: EBITDA (analyst), as the CP-1 table prints it.

leverage.basis: Total debt / EBITDA. Total debt is principal 3,257,482 thousand; net debt deducts cash 1,162,018 and short-term investments 825,000 thousand. Analyst EBITDA 1,419,756 thousand, which includes the 124,133 thousand gain on sale of business (excluding it, total debt to EBITDA would be 2.51x)

coverage.basis: EBITDA / cash interest. Analyst EBITDA 1,419,756 thousand over cash paid for interest 189,256 thousand; cash interest as printed in the cash flow supplement

cash.basis: Cash. Cash and cash equivalents 1,552.9 plus short-term investments 200.0. Undrawn is stated revolver availability. Foreign subsidiary facility headroom is not included. Restricted cash of 583 excluded

cashflow.basis: Net cash from operating activities, as the CP-1 table prints it.

gaps: Host session: an agent answered every module from the pinned filings and CP-5 is its own review. No independent review has been made. Treat the analysis as candidate.
CP-2 main limitation: EBITDA and covenant ratios are analyst figures, and no customer terms, financing documents or sponsor detail are supplied.
CP-1 main limitation: No reported EBITDA or covenant ratio exists, so EBITDA is an analyst measure and covenant headroom is only indicative.
